itemListElement.name: Checkout Link Consistency Gate
itemListElement.description: Add an offline CI check that fails when a static page advertises one product or price but its checkout button points to another. Excludes live provider verification, payment processing, entitlement/tax checks and unverified catalog truth claims.

itemListElement.name: Web3 starter CI green + deterministic test harness
itemListElement.description: Reproduce one CI failure in a small TypeScript/Node or Rust web3 starter, add deterministic offline tests, wire push/PR CI and document scope limits. Excludes security audit, on-chain deployment, validator-backed integration tests and production-outage claims.

itemListElement.name: One bounded issue + regression test PR
itemListElement.description: For one public no-signup repository: reproduce an agreed small issue locally, add a deterministic offline regression test, make a minimal patch, run public tests/CI where available and open a concise PR with handover. Excludes wallet, crypto, captcha, OTP, KYC, paid provider usage, audit, deployment and guaranteed merge.
